reviews.text:
By the time Keez, my 91 lb Dalmatian-Goldendoodle mix, was 3, I had pretty much accepted that walks weren’t going to be part of our life. He had Petco puppy classes and had decided to forget all that when he grew up. I thought about trying to train him myself but I didn’t know where to even start or how to fix the behavior, let alone keep the structure and authority he needed.

Keez was still using pee pads in my apartment, pulled so hard that walks weren’t really an option, was reactive around other dogs, barked at every little noise, howled when I left, and had started getting more aggressive with my cats and people.

I went to CANIS for his assessment, where owner Brent and trainer Christiana talked with me for almost two hours to fully understand Keez and the areas that needed the most attention. After that, I knew what I needed to do. I enrolled him in the 4 week City/Nature Board and Train program.

The facility itself is amazing. It’s huge and so clean, with state-of-the-art equipment for training, exercise, and playtime. They worked him hard there, and by the end he was much leaner and looked amazing, weighing in at 79 lbs! I also got weekly report cards with pictures and videos of his progress, which were the highlight of every week, and got to see that progress firsthand in our Sunday group classes.

It was the best decision I could have made for Keez. Since coming home, he hasn’t had a single accident inside and always goes potty on our walks. He heels, rarely pulls, checks in with me, and is honestly better behaved than most dogs we pass. He’s calmer and more confident at home and around strangers, doesn’t howl when I leave, and has stopped terrorizing my cats. His emotional regulation is top class.

I even took him into Petco recently, which was a nightmare before but this time he was perfectly behaved around the other dogs, people, smells, and distractions.

I can tell by Keez’s excitement when he sees Christiana for our follow up 1:1s that she fully understands, bonds, and cares for all the dogs she trains.

10000/10 highly recommend Christiana, Brent, and the entire CANIS team enough. The investment has paid off tremendously. Keez is definitely still Keez, but now we can enjoy more life together.

After rescuing my dog from the shelter, he became very protective and reactive around new people. Hunter found his specific triggers and personalized a program specifically for my dog. After his 8 week training stay, we have real world practices that will make both of our lives so much easier. With these exercises,
I can better provide for Cane and he is visibly more comfortable around people. Hunter went above and beyond to provide for Cane and I cannot wait to see how he continues to progress. I could not say enough good things about Hunter, his bond with my dog, and his ability to accommodate for Cane’s needs.

We had an absolutely wonderful experience with Canis Dog Behavior and Training’s 5-Week Private Plus Dog Training Program, and we cannot recommend them highly enough! From the very beginning, the program was thoughtful, personalized, and incredibly effective.

Our trainer, Jen, was truly fantastic. She was knowledgeable, patient, encouraging, and genuinely cared about helping both our dog and our family succeed. Jen took the time to understand our dog’s individual personality and needs and gave us practical, easy-to-follow strategies that we could actually incorporate into our everyday lives. She always made us feel supported and never judged, even when we were struggling with something.

Over the five weeks, we saw such a positive transformation—not only in our dog’s behavior and confidence, but also in our own confidence as dog owners. Jen was wonderful at explaining the why behind the training, which made it so much easier for us to understand how to communicate with our dog and reinforce positive behaviors consistently.

The private format was especially valuable because the training was completely tailored to our dog and our specific goals. Every session felt productive, positive, and customized to what we needed at that point in our training journey.

Jen is an absolute gem, and Canis Dog Behavior and Training provides an exceptional program. If you’re considering professional dog training, we wholeheartedly recommend Canis—and especially Jen! We are so grateful for everything she taught us and for the amazing progress we’ve made.

Where to start!  We adopted a puppy and despite all the researching in the world you are never quite ready for the whirlwind that your life becomes when a new puppy enters your life.  We get him through the time when he can't touch the ground in public until after he's fully vaccinated, we get him through neutering, we manage to keep our fingers in the dam through the land shark period of an otherwise super sweet pup, but a puppy all the same and we know we are reaching our limits of youtube videos and subreddits always planning on doing some form of obedience training.  One of us sees a post on Instagram for Canis talking about how to structure your puppy's day and it is a simple repeatable cycle and it is the salve for information overload, sleep deprivation, clothes with holes and bite marks from those super pointy sharp puppy teeth.  The thought dawns on you, "where are these people (Canis) located?"

When we first reached out to Canis we were still a ways away from starting obedience training and socialization, but they could not have been nicer and more helpful with a ton of resources and a lengthy phone call.  That was our first encounter with Kaitlyn who ended up being our dog's lead trainer and now on the other end of this experience we could not have been happier.  She was a great fit for our dog and for us.  Canis did a pretty detailed evaluation of our dog and their expertise was very much on display when they spotted that while he wasn't displaying glaring problem behaviors they could see certain things that if not worked on could become issues...things like shyness and confidence.  Kaitlyn and everyone at Canis took the time to slowly introduce him to different size play groups so that he had positive experiences and gained confidence.  I could go on and on about our experience with Canis when it comes to training.  The entire team brings incredible experience, knowledge and care to training dogs and their people...and that is on purpose because they know that working with both dog and human is key to the success.

Everyone at Canis adds to the welfare of your dog.  We saw that right away and it really was so wonderful to experience.  We did board and train and were nervous in the beginning, but the people and the process at Canis put us at ease pretty quickly.  We can't say enough good things about this experience which continues since we have signed up for the next set of classes to keep the learning going.

Kaitlyn at Canis was absolutely amazing! She was patient, kind and fantastic with our puppy! I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
She was flexible with scheduling and responsive with communicating! We loved getting video and picture updates! Kaitlyn helped transform our puppy into a dog we can take to the baseball field! Can’t thank Canis and Kaitlyn enough!

We can’t say enough good things about Canis Dog Training. They did an absolutely amazing job with our puppy, and the difference has been incredible. He’s truly become part of our family, and we’re so thankful for everything they did.

Kaitlyn was amazing. She was so nice, patient, and you could tell how much she genuinely cared about our Roki. It gave us a lot of comfort knowing he was with someone who treated him like her own.

The entire staff at Canis is fantastic. You can tell they really care about the dogs they work with and take pride in what they do. Our experience couldn’t have been better, and I would recommend them to anyone looking for dog training. Worth every penny!

Started at Canis after I got my 4 month old puppy that was already 45 pounds on his way to 120 pounds.  Brent was so fast to pick up on exactly what skills we needed for my 5'2" body to be able to handle my new dog. We've completed 2 courses and have seen so much improvement.  Puppy cycle was the key, once we got that down everything started falling into place.  I've been re-training my old dog with the skills I've learned at Canis and now both my dogs are more behaved.  I can't wait to start the next course!

This place has our hearts. They take excellent care of our dog, and we love their training and dog-care philosophy. I wish there were more places like them around. Our dog, let's say he's very picky with places and people, and this place was a winner from day one. He stays calm because everyone here is calm and assertive.

Canis did a wonderful job at training my Doberman Pincher "Kikki Hernandez".  When he started his training, he was totally untrained prone to jumping on me, my furniture and acting crazy around the house.  But when his training was complete, he was totally trained, almost a different dog altogether and didn't exhibit any of the behaviors that I brought him in to fix.  And I want to mention that all the trainers were wonderful and consummate professionals at performing their jobs.  And I want to mention that one of the best parts of the training experience was working with Kaitlyn who was the main trainer for Kikki and me and did a fantastic job!
It's palpable that everyone at Canis is really passionate and caring towards the doggies. Our trainer, Kaitlyn, and her assistant, Issa are literally THE BEST.

We just completed a two week board & train session for our mixed breed rescue (Ollie) that had uncontrollable leash aggression toward other dogs. This has made such a noticeable difference in his ability to focus on our commands, and show tolerance toward other dogs while on walks in our neighborhood. We have also used Canis to board and socialize both of our dogs, and could not be happier with the trainers’ professionalism and results. The team at Canis has earned our trust and I would like to give a special shout out to Christiana, James and Magaly for our recent board and train experience. We will be back, and have already scheduled two more classes.

My wife and I have a high energy, rambunctious and highly anxious field golden retriever. We were referred to Canis, and we couldn't have been more thrilled with the decision. While expensive, you get what you pay for, and the team at Canis give you all the tools you need to succeed, including unlimited private training and group classes for a year after the board and train program. Our trainer, Kaitlyn, was incredibly patient with our golden, and we couldn't be more thankful for teaching both our dog and us the tools to live with a high energy dog. Thank you Kaitlyn, Brent and the entire team at Canis!

After having a baby our dog Lambo had a very hard time adjusting. It made postpartum hit harder having to hear everyone tell me I should give away my dog son now that I have my little human. I knew we needed professional help with training but I was afraid because Lambo is already 8 years old and you know the old saying "You can't teach a old dog new tricks". I found Canis Dog Training through a Google search and decided to call based on their reviews. After the evaluation I with The owner and trainer Kaitlyn Prisk I decided to leave Lambo in their hands for the 6 week board and training. Today we brought Lambo back home and I feel so proud of him and grateful for the amazing job Kaitlyn did. Lambo is so well behaved, less anxious, and enjoys being in a crate which I never thought could be possible with him. The help him overcome his separation anxiety he had with me and I can't wait for the rest of my family and friends to see the new Lambo. Most importantly I feel safe with him home along with my 6month old baby. I cannot say enough of how thankful I am.

I did a LOT of research before choosing a board and train program for Murphy. I spoke with multiple trainers, toured and consulted with different facilities, asked a million questions, and was very particular about who I was going to trust with my dog for four weeks. I am so incredibly happy I chose CANIS.

Brennan was Murphy’s primary trainer, and I genuinely cannot say enough wonderful things about him. He is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, thoughtful, and clearly cares about the dogs he works with. But what impressed me just as much is that this absolutely extends to the entire CANIS team. Every person I interacted with was supportive, knowledgeable, encouraging, and so obviously passionate about what they do. You can tell how much they love these dogs and how much pride they take in their work.

What I especially appreciate about CANIS is that they understand a successful board and train isn’t just about training your dog. They have to train you, too. They put so much time and effort into teaching me how to communicate with Murphy, understand what he needs from me, reinforce everything he learned, and continue building on his training at home. They never made me feel silly for asking questions, were incredibly patient while I learned, and made sure I actually understood the why behind what we were doing rather than just handing me back a dog who knew some commands.

Murphy learned an incredible amount in four weeks, but so did I. More importantly, I feel like we came out of the program with a stronger foundation for our life together and a team of people in our corner who genuinely want to see us succeed.

Leaving after graduation was honestly bittersweet because Murphy absolutely loves everyone there, and I’ve grown pretty attached to them too! 😂 Thankfully, this isn’t goodbye. I’m thrilled that I found CANIS and fully intend to continue bringing Murphy back so we can both keep learning.

Brennan and the entire CANIS team, thank you for everything you poured into my little guy (and into me!). We’ll see you again very soon. ❤️

I had a fantastic experience with Hunter and the Canis team! My dog, Honey, was previously quite difficult on the leash and struggled to interact well with other dogs. After just two weeks of training with Hunter, Honey has transformed into a much more manageable walking companion and is now playing nicely with other dogs, showing greater consideration for them.

The training program equipped me with a variety of tools and techniques that I can implement at home. Additionally, the team was incredibly attentive, providing regular updates and promptly answering any questions I had.

Thank you, Hunter and Canis, for your amazing support!

We brought our 5-year-old Husky, Mia, in for training, and from the very beginning, every staff member was amazing. After our initial consultation, we knew this was the right place for us. Since then, they have not only met but exceeded every expectation we had. Christiana was Mia’s trainer, and she did an exceptional job. She, along with the rest of the staff, took the time to build a genuine relationship with Mia, and I truly appreciated how supportive and encouraging they were throughout her entire training journey. If you think your dog is too old to start training, Mia is proof that it’s never too late! We’ve already seen such a positive difference in her, and I’m so excited to continue her journey through the group classes and watch her progress even further. The team is also incredibly flexible and willing to work around your schedule, which made the entire experience even easier. We couldn’t be happier with our experience and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring, knowledgeable, and supportive training team!

My son Rusty has fine-tuned so many of his skills he learned from his board and train in the City Dog group classes! He has become a lot more desensitized to other dogs while on the leash, and can navigate public spaces in a more organized and calm way. I feel way more confident taking him in public and am less anxious about him having a freak out when other dogs are nearby. I highly recommend the City Dog group classes!

I am so glad a neighbor told me about CANIS. The experiences we have had so far have been super positive. We have a 5 y/o pittie/kelpie mix and a 7 month GS/malinois mix. We have had both pups stay with them for short-term boarding, and they always come back happy and well taken care of. However, the real magic of CANIS is the trainers. We were looking to start our Remy (GS/malinois mix) in training right away, as she was definitely living up to the "maligator" nickname, chewing and biting everything and everyone. I chatted with Hunter to learn more about CANIS and the services available. That first conversation immediately put me at ease. Hearing his own experiences of having the same breed pup and all that CANIS could help us with felt like the right decision for us. We signed up for the Puppy Academy I class, and I'm grateful we did. The first class with Brent felt like a lifesaver! He immediately got my pup to calm down when she was acting like an overly anxious, excited pup (I think my jaw literally dropped). Hunter came to meet Remy before class, too, affirming that we made the right decision. We have since completed Puppy Academy I and II with Brent (outdoor long-leash training being something I didn't think we could ever do with our pup), then made the decision to put her in the 4-week boarding and training program. Seeing videos of Remy calmly walking in stores and listening to Hunter's every command made my jaw drop again! Truly the best decision we could have made. Brent, Hunter, and the whole team at CANIS took such great care in training our furry baby and us! They do an excellent job in explaining the psychology of what's happening with our dogs, how we can help them learn good behaviors and make better decisions, and become more confident pet parents. Our Remy is now able to walk on a leash without chewing it, thinks before trying to bark at other people/dogs, and has gotten much better at not lunging at everything and everyone. I feel way more confident when walking her in our neighborhood to the point a neighbor asked if I was a trainer. I HIGHLY recommend CANIS to everyone and will continue to take more classes to keep leveling up our pup's training.

five stars for bobby and jen - they spent over an hour speaking with us and listening to our concerns for our dogs, bowie and bennett. they were patient, non-judgmental, and warm. while we have decided to go to another training program that's closer to home and with our neighbor and their new puppy, i just wanted to say thank you! and let bobby and jen know that our pups did very, very well in big bear (at the airbnb, the lake, and even restaurants and shops!) - maybe they heard and understood your guys' tips! wishing you all, humans and pups alike, only the best.

I had such an amazing experience with Canis Behavior Training! I’m beyond happy with the progress my dog made and I’m so grateful for all the work they put into him. His trainer, Hunter, did an incredible job. He was patient, professional, knowledgeable, and you can really tell he cares about the dogs he works with. The difference I’ve seen in my dog is amazing, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. I definitely recommend Canis Behavior Training to anyone looking for a great training program. Thank you Hunter and the entire Canis team for taking such great care of my boy and doing such an amazing job with him! 🐾❤️
